description: The shared core of the Eclipse gig adapter family: one canonical, owner-approved Task Brief (versioned, SHA-256 hash-bound; any post-approval edit invalidates approval) becomes a native request on each task marketplace through its adapter. The core normalizes quotes from every platform model (lead, stated-budget, fixed-price, hourly) to one record with face price and itemized fees forever separate and a single ALL-IN total; a quote whose fees are UNEXPOSED cannot be hired under a ceiling absent a written per-quote owner exception. The hire gate evaluates a live Eclipse Procure / Agent Wallet mandate (cap, category + platform allowlists, approval threshold, expiry) and returns receipted ALLOW/DENY decisions; in v1, selecting a person requires an owner-confirm token even under a mandate. Completion verification keeps platform state and owner attestation in separate fields (platform-done is not verified), and review drafts are generated only from the verification record. G0 executes nothing and calls nothing live.
